UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and preferences for the app.

hasOnboarded.description: Whether the user has completed the initial onboarding flow.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the profile was created.

habits.description: The habits the user wants to track (Cigarettes, Weed, Vape, Snus).

frequency.description: How often the user partakes in the habit.

started.description: When the user started the habit.

packCost.description: The cost of a single pack of the item they are tracking.

itemsPerPack.description: The number of items in a single pack.

singleCost.description: The cost of a single item if bought individually.

itemsPerDay.description: The average number of items consumed per day.

confidence.description: The user's confidence in achieving their goal.

cravingTime.description: When the user's cravings are strongest.

breakDuration.description: Typical duration of a smoke break.

usualPlace.description: Where the user usually engages in the habit.

usualCompany.description: Who the user is usually with.

mainTrigger.description: The biggest reason for the habit.

stressFrequency.description: How often the user feels stressed.

language.description: The user's preferred language for the app interface and AI content.

shareToCommunity.description: Whether the user has opted-in to sharing their replacement activities to the public community feed.

devices.description: List of connected health data sources.

fcmTokens.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

UrgeEntry.title: UrgeEntry
UrgeEntry.description: Represents a single instance of the user logging a smoking urge. Replaces 'smokes' collection.

timestamp.description: The exact date and time the urge was logged.

context.description: Context of the urge, e.g., after_meal, stress.

notes.description: Optional user-provided notes about the context of the urge.

type.description: The type of habit logged (e.g. Cigarette, Weed)

moodBefore.description: The user's mood when they logged the urge.

moodAfter.description: The user's mood after logging the urge.

narrative.description: An AI-generated first-person narrative of the moment.

shortMessage.description: A short, encouraging message about the moment.

count.description: The number of items (e.g., cigarettes) consumed in this single urge.

hr.description: Heart rate at the time of the event, if available.

ReplacementActivity.title: ReplacementActivity
ReplacementActivity.description: An activity chosen to replace a smoking moment, and the mood associated.

activity.description: A short description of the replacement activity.

mood.description: The user's mood after the replacement activity.

SmokingMoment.title: SmokingMoment
SmokingMoment.description: A user-defined time and label for a recurring smoking habit.

id.description: A unique identifier for the moment.

time.description: The time of the planned smoke, in HH:mm format (e.g., '09:00').

label.description: A short description for the moment (e.g., 'Morning coffee').

completed.description: A map of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to a boolean indicating if the smoke happened.

replacementActivity.description: A map of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to an object describing the replacement activity and mood.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: A record of a push notification sent to a user.

body.description: The body content of the notification.

timestamp.description: The timestamp when the notification was sent.

read.description: Whether the user has viewed the notification in the app.

link.description: The URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.

CommunityPost.title: CommunityPost
CommunityPost.description: A public post made by a user when they log a replacement activity.

userId.description: The ID of the user who created the post.

username.description: The display name of the user at the time of posting.

activity.description: The replacement activity that was performed.

momentLabel.description: The label of the smoking moment that was replaced.

likeIds.description: Array of user IDs who liked this post.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A comment on a community post.

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the comment.

username.description: The display name of the commenter.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent comment, if this is a reply.

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Represents a connected health data source.

id.description: Unique identifier for the device or service.

type.description: The type of health data source.

Measurement.title: Measurement
Measurement.description: A single piece of telemetry data from a health source.

hr.description: Heart rate in beats per minute.

Detection.title: Detection
Detection.description: A record of a suspected or confirmed smoking event.

hr.description: Heart rate at the time of detection.

baseline.description: The user's baseline heart rate at the time.

score.description: The confidence score of the detection (0-1).

confirmed.description: Whether the user confirmed this was a smoking event.

'/users/{userId}'.description: A singleton document storing the user's app-specific profile and settings.

'/users/{userId}/urges/{urgeId}'.description: A collection of all smoking urges logged by a specific user. This collection is the source of truth for 'smokes'.

'/users/{userId}/measurements/{measureme.description: A collection of time-series health data from connected devices.

'/users/{userId}/detections/{detectionId.description: A log of smoking events suspected by the backend heuristic.

'/users/{userId}/notifications/{notifica.description: A collection of notifications sent to the user.

'/community_posts/{postId}'.description: A collection of all public replacement activity posts from all users.

'/community_posts/{postId}/comments/{com.description: Subcollection of comments for a specific community post.
